thread:
kai: Pitched a couple of small UX experiments for the Embeddings preview: 1) export presets (CSV / JSONL / JSONL+metadata), 2) column visibility + sticky relevance score, 3) compact density toggle. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/embed-presets
ellie: Nice. For presets, can we show a short preview of the header row so non-technical folks know what fields are included? E.g., "id, text, vector_dim_1536". Keep it truncated.
devin: Tiny a11y point: the preset dropdown needs proper aria-expanded and aria-controls. Also keyboard support for arrow keys between presets. We'll want live region announcements when a preset is applied: "Preset \"CSV (basic)\" applied".
sasha: Copy: presets labels should be action-oriented: "Download: CSV (basic)", "Download: JSONL (full)" rather than just file-type. That helps users scan quickly.
kai: Agree. UX idea: if user toggles "include vectors" we should show a warning tooltip: "Including full vectors increases file size dramatically" and show estimated file size for sample selection count.
ellie: Contrast/accessibility: compact density uses 11px metadata text currently. Fails color contrast at small sizes. Either bump to 12/13px or bold it. Also keep 4px minimum touch target on mobile for the density toggle.
devin: Regarding column resizing: avoid mouse-only handles. Allow arrow-key nudges when column header is focused and announce new width in px/percent. Use role=slider pattern for resize control.
sasha: Relevance table sorting discussion: should primary sort default to "relevance" or "recent"? I vote for relevance in the inspector, recent in search results view.
kai: Let's default inspector to relevance. Add a small breadcrumb/helper text: "Results sorted by relevance. Change sort ->" so it's discoverable.
aria-bot: Accessibility reminder: when rows are selectable, announce "N items selected" in a polite live region. Ensure the selection toolbar appears after the table in DOM so keyboard users land on it predictably.
devin: Telemetry names: I'll put these in the proto: `embed_preset_applied`, `embed_download_requested`, `embed_download_started`, `embed_download_queued`. Include properties: `preset_name`, `include_vectors`, `selected_count`.
ellie: Export flow edge-case: if user maps their own CSV headers (column mapping), show a small review screen before export with preview of first 3 rows and a checkbox "Apply header mapping to all exports".
sasha: Iconography: the rerank icon is pretty similar to reorder/drag icons. Can we use a distinct arrow pair up/down with a label "Rerank" on hover? Keyboard users should also have a shortcut like "r" when a row is focused.
kai: I'll add a low-fidelity prototype with the mapping review modal and the presets preview. Also added alt text for the preview thumbnails and tested focus traps in the modal. PTAL and leave a short thumbs or comment by EOD. Thanks everyone.
